# Open Ethics Standard

> An ethical standard for any business: eight principles (Honesty, Autonomy, Privacy, Fairness, Care, Safety, Accountability, Responsibility beyond the customer) and 800+ named practices that break them. To apply it to a software project, use the local MCP server (`npx -y open-ethics-standard-mcp@latest`, Node.js 20+), which lets an AI coding assistant review a project against the standard. Reports are saved on the user's machine; findings never leave it. No account or API key required.

- [Agent guide](https://ike5.github.io/open-ethics-standard/agent-setup.md): The review workflow, report format, and reply format. Start here.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/open-ethics-standard-mcp): The local stdio MCP server and catalog CLI.
- [The standard](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard/blob/main/OPEN-ETHICS-STANDARD.md): The principles (Part I) and canonical practice definitions.
- [Source](https://github.com/ike5/open-ethics-standard): MCP source and contribution guide.
